messages:
Elena Park: Draft one-pager idea for enterprise outsized: short 1-page that sales can drop into emails and AE calls. Focus: security controls + SLA options + clear routing for inbound. Need: 1) hero headline + 2 variants, 2) 3 social blurbs, 3) compact benchmark callouts (no raw tokens in headline), 4) HubSpot property mapping for routing, 5) webinar mention to drive pipeline. Goal: ship asset + webinar invite template by Fri. Thoughts?

Ben Ortiz: love one-pager. Headline options from me: 
- "Inference you can bank on: secure, SLA-backed deployments."
- "Predictable LLM serving for regulated teams."
Either works, leaning toward first. Social blurb ideas (short):
1) "Secure, SLA-backed LLM inference — request a capacity review: <link>"
2) "From sandbox to SLA: how teams move safely to production with Redwood: <link>"
3) "Benchmark: consistent p95 latency under 100-150ms across real workloads — see details: <link>"
Pick tone and I9ll prep variants for LinkedIn/Twitter.

Samir Rao: benchmark copy: prefer two headlines we can A/B test on the PDF front: Reliability angle and Economics angle. Reliability blurb (one-liner): "Sustained p95 < 140ms, p99 < 260ms at steady throughput on Dedicated clusters (validated)." Economics blurb: "Typical customers see 30-50% lower serving cost vs self-managed stacks after optimizing batching & caching." Note: I want to keep ranges and avoid absolute claims in the headline. Aisha, confirm numbers?

Aisha (eng-ops): Confirmed: public-friendly validated snapshot from 2026-02-15 run: p95 = 132ms, p99 = 248ms at ~180 tps on dedicated A100 config with 512 tokens steady-state. Cost reduction range is realistic for customers who adopt reserved pools + quantization; callout: savings vary by model and seq len.

Noah Li: Routing fields for HubSpot form (proposed):
```
- deployment_mode: single-select [hosted, dedicated, private]
- sla_needed: boolean
- estimated_annual_spend: single-select [<50k, 50k-250k, 250k-1M, >1M]
- compliance_requirements: multi-select [SOC2, HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP, Other]
- want_capacity_review: boolean
```
Routing rules (simple):
```
if want_capacity_review == true or sla_needed == true -> assign: Enterprise AE queue
if estimated_annual_spend == ">1M" -> tag: high_value and notify solutions-eng
else -> standard marketing nurture
```
Also add hidden field utm_campaign for webinar + lead source. I'll build the form and map the properties.

Elena Park: Webinar tie-in: live webinar "From Proof-of-Concept to SLA: enterprise inference patterns" 45 min incl Q&A. Use one-pager as downloadable asset. Panel: 1 customer (healthcare), 1 AE+SE case study, 1 eng lead. Moderator: Ben? Proposed date: Tue 2 weeks out, 10am PT. Ben can you moderate and own LinkedIn event copy?

Ben Ortiz: I can moderate. Will draft event description and three social copy types: announcement, reminder, post-event recap. Also will craft two hero headline variants for one-pager and attach short speaker bullets for AE.

Samir Rao: Speaker Qs for webinar (draft):
1) "What changed in your risk posture after moving to Redwood?"
2) "Which SLA targets mattered most and why?"
3) "How did cost predictability influence roadmap choices?"
I9ll also prep a micro-benchmark slide (no raw logs) showing latency bands by throughput.

Aisha (eng-ops): AE handoff sheet: include quick fields: deployment_mode, sla_needed, compliance_requirements, preferred_region, current_infra (self-managed/cloud), expected_traffic_profile. I'll add a short checklist for required docs for private deployments (network contact, certs, KMS preference).

Elena Park: Great. Action list: Ben finalize two headline variants + social copy, Samir finalize benchmark lines and slide, Noah wire form & routing, Aisha finalize AE handoff checklist, Elena assemble one-pager and webinar landing + email template. Freeze copy by Thu EOD so legal can review.

launch-bot: Asset milestone created: one-pager + webinar landing. Reminders scheduled for 72h and 24h before freeze.

Ben Ortiz: will post LinkedIn draft by EOD tomorrow.

Elena Park: Thanks team 680 4c4
